shadowType: THREE.PCFShadowMap,

replace:
shadowType: THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap,
    // The radius whose penumbra matches
why: PCFSoftShadowMap is still exported by three r186, so naming it type-checks -- and `WebGLShadowMap.render()` then substitutes PCFShadowMap and warns to the console. That is how issue #800 shipped a third-narrower penumbra on the default preset with every test green: the preset read back as the filter it asked for everywhere the renderer had not drawn yet. A preset may only name a filter this three.js implements.
